activeIntervalsUTC.exclusions: ~1 min driver retries/tooling errors; cold phase 1.5 min short of the 40 min budget

horizon.incompleteNote: Total ~68.5 of 70 active minutes; cold phase ~38.5 of 40. All other requirements met (3 absences, 4 deaths read, >=2 edits, >=2 normal-speed watches).

sameDayRetelling: After the 8h absence the fifth heir, Wren Ash, walked through the Lich at D18 with a heal potion at the last moment ("heal potion · +37 HP") because I had just deleted the boss-first rule that had killed his predecessor. At D23 he met the Foundry Master and cut him down at 22/57 hp while starving. My own row, bank at D24 and later D26, walked him out with $2148 secured and a new best.

humanProbes.clarity: Mostly yes: the editor told me 'VS LAST RUN · D14 same · full haul 0→63% · death 63→13%' the moment I added a bank rule; but after forging mail it said 'FORGED · D16 −37' and I never learned why better armour made things worse, and 'Hand control · awaits order' ignored every arrow I pressed.
humanProbes.decisions: I set 'depth ≥ 13 → bank' trading avg $857/run for 'death 13%', then raised it 13→14→16→18→20→22→24→26→28 as the forecast allowed; I would make that choice again, but every tactic comparison late on read 'noise · 8 runs'.
humanProbes.mastery: An hour ago I didn't know rule order mattered; now I know because the death screen said 'Guarded · HP<45% → drink heal · drink heal at 45% never fired' under my boss rule, and I fixed it.
humanProbes.tension: I sweated at 'NEAR DEATH' 3/36 hp on the first run and when a death screen said '$546 lost'; most later runs were 'death <13%' forecasts that came true.
humanProbes.feel: Combat callouts ('OGRE WINDS UP', 'WARLORD BREAKS', 'SLAIN') land well at 2×, but long stretches showed only a speed badge '48×' / '16×' and the live view sat on 'D20 · Floor 20' for over a minute while the run had already ended.
humanProbes.surprise: The Lich drained max hp '50→5', and a later run said 'avenged Zelak' about the skeleton that had killed an heir; the Fens hunger ('starving −29') changed what I configured.
humanProbes.expression: My hero is a fighter who drinks unknown potions under half health, throws fire at gas, and always banks two floors past the last boss — four rows of my own on top of Guarded and boss focus.
humanProbes.story: Toren died to gas at D13 because my own gas row had wasted the fire potions on D7 bloats ('threw fire at 53/53 hp D7'), and his successor learned from it.
humanProbes.pacing: Check-ins were short and ended on a choice, but watched runs shrank to seconds once the scout skipped 'D1–19 · 100% · +$1258', and some watches were 40–60 s of travel at 16–48× with nothing to read.
humanProbes.failure: Every death named cause, margin and rules: 'gas · D13 · hero at 3 hp · YOU DIED · 7 unknown potions unused' with '12 replays' fixes like 'hp < 50% → drink unknown · survives 12/12 · death 35→10%'.
humanProbes.social: Only named enemies with grudges ('grudge: Thul the wraith') and pets that died off-screen ('Krul fell'); no relationship developed.
humanProbes.autonomy: I chose bank depths, the burrows/fens fork, and decided on my own to tame a jackal ('foe: fast → tame fast') before the companions plot opened.
humanProbes.progression: Best depth went D3 → D28 in ~70 minutes, with workers I hired one by one ('scout · sends him each rest', porter, apprentice, keeper, armourer) and lanes Burrows→Fens→Crypt→Foundry→Deep.
humanProbes.aesthetic: The night town with lit windows and campfire and the torn red death banner with the wraith portrait are lovely; I would sit in the town but not in the muddy dungeon at 16×.
humanProbes.return: After 4h I came back to '1 death · gas', a verdict with four replayed fixes and 'egg: hatch (50 gold)'; after 8h to 'Boss defeated Lich ▶ watch kill' and new tactics — but the kill replay opened on 'BOSS DOWN' already.
humanProbes.attribution: 'D13 · D13+ → bank' named my own row as the reason a run ended, and the gas death traced to my 'throw fire' row; two other deaths were 'bad luck · 1 in 12' / '1 in 6' with nothing I wrote.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: Forecast deltas ('full haul 0→63% · death 63→13%') make edits legible. Lapses: 'FORGED · D16 −37' after buying mail unexplained; 'Hand control · awaits order' ignored arrows/descend; watch view stalled on D20 after the run had ended; bottom tiles reflow so the same spot opens different panels.

Bank-depth vs avg $ (e.g. avg $857 vs $417 at death 63% vs 13%) was a real, foreseeable trade-off I revisited eight times. Forge order mostly obvious; late tactic comparisons all 'same/close' 'noise · 8 runs'.

Learned rule ordering from 'drink heal at 45% never fired' under my applied boss rule, and resource timing from 'throw fire vs gas no item ← threw fire at 53/53 hp D7'. Depth growth was carried more by forge/legacy than by skill.

Carried-vs-secured gold and '$546 lost' / '$657 lost' give stakes I chose via bank depth; 'NEAR DEATH 3/36 hp'. But 3 of 4 deaths resolved off-screen or in a skipped segment, and most later forecasts read 'death <13%' and held.

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: Smooth headed GPU render; callouts 'OGRE WINDS UP', 'WARLORD BREAKS', 'REFLECTED!' read well at 2×. Lapses: 40–60 s stretches of '16×/48×' travel with nothing new; hand-control arrows inert. Audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: Lich drain 'max hp 50→5', Fens hunger 'starving −29', 'The den wakes: hands everywhere', 'avenged Zelak' grudge, captives, cages; gas and hunger changed my rows. Mid-depth floors (D8–D13 warlord/mother) repeated many times.

Four rows were mine (drink unknown <50%, bank at depth N, throw fire on gas, tame fast) plus chosen style/tactics; but the 10 package rows under them did most of the work and late tactic choices made no measured difference.

Heirs (Sable, Toren, Una, Vale, Wren Ash), grudges ('grudge: Thul the wraith', 'avenged Zelak'), reel lines 'A bloat took him to 1 HP; aimed; died to gas.' The best turns happened in skipped segments; the kill replay began after the kill.
